# Cryostat Vendor Shortlist

## Purpose

This note lists the vendors we asked for a quote on the small cryostat for the test stand. The stand itself is described in [[Test Stand Plan]]. The words we use for parts and limits are in [[Glossary]]. The list is invented for the harness test and names no real company. Each candidate gets one paragraph with the facts we collected and the date we collected them, so the numbers can be checked later against the quote file.

## Candidates

Vendor Alpha quoted a bath cryostat with a 200 millimetre bore and a four week lead time. Vendor Beta offers a pulse tube unit that needs no liquid helium but costs about twice as much and needs a 15 kilowatt compressor. Vendor Gamma sent only a brochure and a phone number, so their entry is empty until someone calls them. All three quotes were collected in the week of 2026-09-14 and filed in the procurement folder.

## Evaluation criteria

We score each cryostat on bore diameter, base temperature, hold time, lead time and price, in that order. A unit that cannot reach four kelvin is out no matter the price. Lead time matters because the test stand schedule in [[Test Stand Plan]] has the first cold test in November. Price is last because the grant covers the unit either way. The scoring table is kept in the same folder as the quotes.

## Open questions

Nobody has confirmed whether Vendor Alpha's bore is the clear inner diameter or the flange diameter. The pulse tube option needs a vibration study before it can be used with the probe. We also do not know whether the lab's power feed can take a 15 kilowatt compressor, which is a question for the facilities note in [[Weekly Log 2026-09]]. A dangling reference to [[Missing Note]] stays here on purpose so the sync test sees an unresolved link.

## Next steps

Call Vendor Gamma. Ask Vendor Alpha for the clear bore. Ask facilities about the power feed. Then rescore and pick one by the end of the month, and record the choice in the weekly log.
